context: Source: found on 2026-11-13 while delivering the agent-facing work (PRs BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4202, #4203 and BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#152, #153, #154). Can share a branch with site-docs-cli-contract-changes-20261113, which documents the new exit codes, validate command, guard and host-load fields. description:
Problem: while writing the methodology page, these contradictions were found on benchbox.dev (site repository BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site): contributing-results and hosted-submission use --scale 0.01 as the submission example, but submit refuses unofficial subscale results; reference/cli/run.md omits --iterations and states loose validation tolerance as 5 percent where the code uses 50 percent; utilities.md says power_run defaults to 4 iterations and 0 warm-up where 3 and 1 are observed; the integrity-validator page and the code disagree on check severities; and the MCP reference says resources are reached only through tools while also listing static resources.

Outcome: each page states current behaviour, verified by running the command.
